notes: faces right, feet on the bottom row; ranged only (no melee). cast: 0-2 plant and raise the lightning-rod staff, 3-6 arcs gather at the prongs (brighter each frame), 6 = held peak (telegraph at the staff tip), 7 = release flash: spawn the chain bolt at spawn.cast.at, 8-11 recover. The coil/prongs are the only light source (a small cold-blue point light at the staff tip suits idle/cast). death: recoils, a last discharge arcs from the staff into the floor (frame 1), kneels and collapses into sodden robes, staff lying beside them.
